review.summary: Fix for a real parsing bug where multiline function signatures with type annotations were incorrectly parsed as tuples instead of calls when newlines appeared between parentheses. The issue clearly demonstrates incorrect behavior compared to the single-line equivalent.
review.evidence: Issue #580 documents a concrete parsing defect: `function (\n::A\n)() end` was parsed as `(function (tuple ...) (block))` instead of the correct `(function (call (parens ...)) (block))`. The single-line version `function (::A)() end` parsed correctly, demonstrating inconsistency. The fix modifies src/julia/parser.jl (production code) and test/parser.jl (test file), targeting the `peek(ps, 2)` check that didn't account for newlines in multiline signatures.
